sentences.text: 3. I have considered the submissions made by the learned counsel for the appellant and have gone through the grounds stated in the Memo of Appeal.
4. This appeal is admitted.
Let the records of MAC Case No.2731/2018 be called for from the concerned Tribunal.

6. Let notice be issued to the respondents.
